requirements.requirement: Wall-hung spice rack with at least three bins
requirements.evidence: Three half-depth bins: bin:0,-1,0~hex-bin-half, bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-half, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-half on three adjacent cells forming a horizontal row suitable for wall mounting.
Two keyhole hangers: accessory:0#0,-1#0 and accessory:0#1,0#0 on outer cells' back faces, providing two-point wall suspension.

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell horizontal wall-hung rack with three half-depth bins and two keyhole hangers on outer cells, with small vessels placed as spice jar stand-ins.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Your spice rack is on the way — I'll hang at least three bins on keyhole brackets.
